decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the play area is used.

Condition : 3 - Soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details. The works should be carried out in accordance with a programme agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 4 - Details of the management of the play area and associated landscaping hereby approved, including hours of use, maintenance and security, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the use.

Condition : 5 - Informative: The provision of play equipment should take account of the guidelines of the National Playing Fields Association and British Standard BS EN1176 in the interests of safety.
description: Refurbishment of existing playground to form combined football /basketball enclosure and toddlers play area.
